<div class="card-body">
'''Ket Maliss''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ケット・マリス</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：戦士技能を持たないキャラクターに配備して（ドロイドは除く）、戦士［戦士アイコン］技能を持たせる。２：戦士キャラクターに配備して、戦闘力＋１とする。（「意識操作」の効果を受けない）</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-PSA-15-Face.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Ket Maliss (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Ket-Maliss-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ジャバ・ザ・ハットやギャング達は、暗殺者を重用する。プリンス・シゾールの“シャドウ・キラー”である彼は、モス・アイズリーで血生臭い秘密任務についている。</span>''
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Ket Maliss.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. Deploy on a non-warrior except a droid to give warrior skill. Or deploy on a warrior for power +1. (Not affected by Mind Manipulation.)

'''Lore:''' Jabba the Hutt and other gangsters place great value on assassins. Prince Xizor's ‘shadow killer’ is on a bloody secret mission in Mos Eisley.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore calls the mission bloody and secret; the English calls his business unknown but undoubtedly lethal. The Japanese numbers the two deployment options and uses 意識操作 for the card named Alter in the English printing.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Ket Maliss]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
